observations.title: CDP browser automation for UI screenshot capture
observations.technical_explanation: The script uses Node net/child_process to connect to a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint and drives page navigation, DOM evaluation, viewport emulation, and element interaction to capture UI screenshots of the Directive mission subtab. All network activity is CDP control traffic to a local automated browser. The evaluate calls inject expressions referencing globalThis.Directive bridge and action APIs to programmatically open the runtime panel and select the mission tab. This is consistent with the stated tooling file role and project purpose.
observations.layman_explanation: The script automates a browser to take screenshots of the extension's interface for documentation or testing. It opens the page, clicks the right buttons, and captures the screen. This is normal developer tooling.

observations.title: CDP navigation command is a browser-control sink, not a credential exfiltration channel
observations.technical_explanation: connection.send('Page.navigate', { url: BASE_URL }) is a DevTools Protocol command sent over a local debugging socket to steer a browser instance for screenshot capture. The URL is a navigation target, not a credential payload, and the socket is a browser-control channel rather than an external network endpoint.
observations.layman_explanation: The code is telling a local browser which page to open for taking screenshots, not transmitting secrets to a remote server.

observations.title: SillyTavern prompt key constants flagged as generic API keys
observations.technical_explanation: The surrounding function enumerates known SillyTavern prompt key names such as worldInfoBefore, worldInfoAfter, 1_memory, customDepthWI_, customWIOutlet_, and 2_floating_prompt to determine which external prompt lanes are active. These are public, stable SillyTavern slot identifiers embedded as string literals for comparison logic only. They are not credentials and are not used in any authentication or outbound request context.
observations.layman_explanation: The code checks for standard SillyTavern prompt slot names to figure out which prompt features are turned on. These names are well-known identifiers, not secrets, so the scanner alert is a false positive.

observations.title: Live smoke-test auth flow targets only the SillyTavern instance under test
observations.technical_explanation: Across ensureRequestAuth(), requestHeaders(), and http(), all credential-bearing requests are directed at BASE_URL, which is asserted as the required SillyTavern base URL before any live HTTP check. Credentials originate from environment variables or from a same-origin /csrf-token bootstrap and are reused only for subsequent requests to that same instance. No alternate destination, encoding, obfuscation, or persistence of credentials is present in the supplied context.
observations.layman_explanation: The test script only sends login details to the SillyTavern server it is checking, not to any other place. This is the expected behavior for a live integration test.
